_comment: Descriptor for layout/bin/pex-netlist.py -- which composed, DRC-clean and
LVS-clean cells under layout/ are re-extracted WITH parasitics and folded
into one ngspice-runnable post-layout library. Read that script's module
docstring for why each rewrite exists and layout/pex/README.md for what
the resulting library is and is not evidence of.
library         output file, relative to this descriptor
expect_device_models
the device subcircuits `klt extract --pdk` is expected to
write. NOT a rewrite map -- klt already emits these; this
is the allowlist the build ASSERTS every device card
against, so a klt that changed the written form (back to
deck-native M cards, or to a different device flavor) is
a hard error rather than a silently wrong netlist.
deck_scale      the `.option scale=` a deck including this library must
set. `klt extract --pdk` writes unitless geometry, which
means micrometres at this scale and something else at any
other; the build asserts every geometry value is in fact
unsuffixed. A contract with the testbench, not decoration.
substrate_net   the extractor's substrate return node, emitted .global
(klayout-tools#1503). A deck must tie it explicitly.
cells[].ports   the DESIGN's own port order for this cell, from
design/ro_array_core.spice's .subckt line -- the wrapper
subcircuit's port list, so a post-layout deck reads like
the pre-layout one.
cells[].net_aliases
extractor joined net name -> design-level net name. A
cell composed in two passes carries a pin label and a
net label on one physical net and the extractor joins
them; naming the survivor here keeps the choice
reviewable instead of inferred. Every joined name in an
extracted netlist must appear here or the build fails.
